content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The CSO's primary responsibility is to acquire customers, expand the branch's sustainable business portfolio and manage field-level customer relationships. Identify potential new business locations. Source and add eligible prospective customers. Support sustainable growth of the branch customer portfolio. Carry out field operations involving the target customer population. Collect loan instalments from customers on scheduled dates after disbursement. Job Nature: This is a field-work position requiring customer visits, sourcing and scheduled collection activities. It should not be confused with a purely office-based customer service or data-entry role.

Select Apply and follow the instructions provided for that position. For the Customer Service Officer position, interested applicants can send their resume to [email protected] , as stated in the job profile. Include accurate contact information and relevant educational and experience details in the resume. Complete the application before the relevant closing date.
